name: context7
description: Fetch up-to-date, version-pinned documentation and code examples for any library via the Context7 MCP server — resolve library IDs, then pull the exact docs you need without guessing APIs.

interface.shortDescription: Look up live, version-pinned docs for any library.
interface.longDescription: Context7 exposes a single MCP toolset that lets agents resolve any library to a Context7 ID and pull the current, version-pinned documentation and code examples directly from the source. Use it whenever the user asks about a library whose API may have drifted from your training data — Next.js, React, Hono, Zod, Stripe, Prisma, Tailwind, the MCP spec, and thousands more. Backed by the official @upstash/context7-mcp server. Connects to the hosted endpoint by default and switches to a local stdio server when a CONTEXT7_API_KEY is present.
defaultPrompt: Use Context7 whenever the user asks about a library, framework, or SDK whose API may have changed since training.
Always call `resolve-library-id` first, then `get-library-docs` with a focused topic.
Cite the version reported by Context7 in the final answer.
